faqs.question: How can I update my profile details?
faqs.answer: Log in to your TechNova account, navigate to Account Settings -> Profile, edit your details (such as name, phone number, or display preferences), and click 'Save Changes'.

faqs.question: How do I delete or deactivate my account?
faqs.answer: To permanently delete or deactivate your account, go to Account Settings -> Privacy & Data -> Delete Account. Please note this action is irreversible and will erase your saved preferences and order history.

faqs.question: Can I transfer my account ownership to another email?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can update your primary account email by going to Account Settings -> Security -> Primary Email, entering the new email address, and verifying it via the confirmation link sent to the new inbox.

faqs.question: How can I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Go to the TechNova login page and select 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address and follow the password-reset link sent to your inbox.

faqs.question: What are the password requirements for TechNova?
faqs.answer: TechNova passwords must be at least 8 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character (e.g. @, #, $).

faqs.question: How do I enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
faqs.answer: Open Account Settings -> Security -> Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the provided QR code using Google Authenticator, Authy, or Duo, then enter the 6-digit confirmation code.

faqs.question: What should I do if I suspect an unauthorized login?
faqs.answer: If you notice unrecognized activity, go to Account Settings -> Active Sessions and click 'Log Out All Devices'. Immediately reset your password and verify your 2FA settings.

faqs.question: Where can I view and download my invoices?
faqs.answer: Navigate to Account Settings -> Billing & Invoices. You will see a chronological list of past transactions with buttons to download PDF invoices.

faqs.question: Why was I charged twice for the same billing cycle?
faqs.answer: Duplicate charges can occur if a transaction attempt timed out while processing. Any authorization holds automatically clear within 3-5 business days. If both charges post, please contact our billing team with your transaction IDs.

faqs.question: Can I get a tax-exempt status for my company invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Business accounts can submit their VAT / GST / Tax ID under Billing Settings -> Business Information to apply tax exemption to future billing statements.

faqs.question: What payment methods are supported?
faqs.answer: Customers can pay using supported credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), debit cards, UPI, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal.

faqs.question: Why was my payment declined?
faqs.answer: Payments may be declined due to insufficient funds, incorrect CVV/expiry date, bank fraud blocks, or international card restrictions. We recommend verifying your card details or contacting your card issuer.

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure on TechNova?
faqs.answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted using AES-256 and PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant gateways. TechNova never stores your full card credentials on our servers.

faqs.question: How can I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Open Account Settings -> Subscription -> Manage Subscription -> Cancel Subscription. You will retain full plan access until the end of your current billing period.

faqs.question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faqs.answer: Go to Account Settings -> Subscription -> Change Plan. Select your desired plan (Starter, Professional, or Enterprise). Upgrades take effect immediately with pro-rated billing.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial for premium features?
faqs.answer: Yes, TechNova offers a 14-day free trial on the Professional Plan with no credit card required at sign-up.

faqs.question: Where is my order and how can I track it?
faqs.answer: You can track your order by clicking 'My Orders' in your account menu or visiting the Order Tracking page with your Order Reference Number (e.g. ORD-9821). Tracking updates appear within 24 hours of shipment.

faqs.question: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement from My Orders -> Cancel Order. Once an order enters processing/fulfillment, it cannot be modified.

faqs.question: What shipping options and delivery timelines are available?
faqs.answer: We offer Standard Shipping (3-5 business days), Express Shipping (1-2 business days), and International Shipping (7-14 business days depending on customs).

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, TechNova ships to over 60 countries worldwide. Duties and taxes are calculated at checkout based on destination customs guidelines.

faqs.question: How long does a refund take?
faqs.answer: Approved refunds are generally processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method, depending on your bank's processing timelines.

faqs.question: What is TechNova's return and refund policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for software subscriptions and unused hardware products in original packaging. Requests after 30 days require special support authorization.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund for an unused partial month subscription?
faqs.answer: Subscription cancellations stop future renewals, but partial month refunds are not issued automatically unless requested within 48 hours of billing.

faqs.question: What should I do if the web app fails to load or shows a 500 error?
faqs.answer: Try clearing your browser cache and cookies, disabling ad-blockers, or switching to an incognito window. You can also verify service health at status.technova.com.

faqs.question: How do I generate an API key for integrations?
faqs.answer: Go to Account Settings -> Developer Tools -> API Keys, click 'Create New Key', assign permissions, and save the key string securely.

faqs.question: Which web browsers are supported by TechNova?
faqs.answer: TechNova supports the latest versions of Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, and Microsoft Edge.

faqs.question: How do I troubleshoot mobile app sync issues?
faqs.answer: Ensure your mobile device has active internet, force-close the TechNova app, and re-open it. If issues persist, check app updates in App Store or Google Play Store.
